explanation: The visible question is the server-rendered fallback form. React replaces its radios wholesale when it hydrates, so a Space press that lands before hydration checks a control that is then unmounted: no answer is posted and nothing errors. The spec hand-rolls its entry and so skipped the hydration wait that the shared helpers perform.
fix: Call the exported waitForHydration(page) after the question is visible and before the first key press; keep the toPass retry for later re-renders.
